description:
Delete the executor's whole-repository graph-rule evaluation, the validation captures only it used, and the graph entry points that only the replaced view and checker pipelines called.

## Background

- `evaluate_graph_rules` (`crates/jit/src/commands/validate.rs:1489`) evaluates every graph rule over a caller-supplied issue list with rules and namespaces from the executor's disk caches, and `image_plan_content` (`:1545`) captures a whole validation image to read plan documents for it. `capture_validation_image` (`:130`, private) serves `image_plan_content` and the former rule view; `capture_validation_image_with` (`:146`, `pub(crate)`) serves it and test fixtures (`commands/gate_check.rs` tests at `:2769,2804,2866`; the overlay tests that judge capture).
- `validation::graph::evaluate_graph_scoped` (`crates/jit/src/validation/graph.rs:432`), `evaluate_graph_rule` (`:560`) and `graph_rule_plan_source_ids` (`:501`) were called only by the former scope and rule views and checkers. All are public, so the build does not flag them.
- Their remaining callers are `graph.rs` tests whose properties are now selection properties, each with an owner: `test_scoped_container_pointer_resolves_outside_slice_and_skips` (`:2728`) by the scope view's out-of-scope container test and the Scope clause of the selection property test; `test_scoped_container_pointer_unresolvable_in_full_index_is_config_error` (`:2768`) by the unresolvable-pointer graph test (`:2702`) and the container-pointer index tests; `test_rule_scoped_evaluation_isolates_firing_issue_from_repository_context` (`:4448`) by the Rule clause of the selection property test.
- Remaining test callers of `evaluate_graph_rules`: the `warnings_for` helper in `crates/jit/tests/fast_rules/cli_warnings_integration_tests.rs:77-85` and one call in `tests/fast_rules/config_loading_tests.rs`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `evaluate_graph_rules`, `image_plan_content`, `capture_validation_image` and `capture_validation_image_with` no longer exist; their test callers capture through the validation capture the views use.
- [hard] REQ-02: `evaluate_graph_scoped`, `evaluate_graph_rule` and `graph_rule_plan_source_ids` and the three `graph.rs` tests that call them no longer exist; each removed case is owned by the selection, scope or pointer test named in Background.
- [hard] REQ-03: The migrated `evaluate_graph_rules` callers assert the same properties through the report or the findings issue creation returns.

## Notes

- Behaviour is unchanged.
- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: Remove the executor's graph evaluation and the scoped graph entry points
